# KINGrinder K6 Onshape inputs

Place the owner's unmodified `Grinder.step` and `Handle.step` here before building the K6 references. The adapter reads those exact AP242 solids, not an STL or a hand-redrawn approximation. Their hashes identify the revision used for the dimensional report:

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| Grinder.step | `be57157f132f50c933144ba17c024fb6790c2d170fdd86677aa305884e50ba3e` |
| Handle.step | `5b31dc0b483e8aa4f5deaacc5d1652a71044fd831c9f22da59b3156dabd65bb9` |

The raw originals are not distributed by this public repository. The CAD source and [layout measurements](../../src/equipment/coffee/kingrinder_k6.md) are versioned here.
